evidence.quote: Owned intelligence is not the same as rented intelligence.

observations.why: Opposed terms (owned vs rented) set against each other as matched noun phrases within one frame, performing a contrast rather than describing a property.

evidence.quote: The substrate is a commodity; the perspective is the asset you keep.

observations.why: Two matched clauses (X is a Y; the Z is the W) with opposed values (commodity vs asset) in the same slots.
